name: openclaw-faster-whisper-transcription
description: Local Faster-Whisper provider for OpenClaw browser dictation

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-isolation=none tests/*.test.mjs && .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py"
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs *.json docs/*.md README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs *.json docs/*.md README.md
scripts.package:check: npm run build && mkdir -p .local && npm pack --dry-run --json --ignore-scripts > .local/package-manifest.json && node scripts/check-package.mjs .local/package-manifest.json
